notes.title: Hotfix Released for Collision Issues
notes.notes: There were a lot of collision issues that crept in somehow. I'm not sure how, likely an internal change to the game engine I use. Either way, these should mostly be fixed with this hotfix.

notes.title: Version 2022-004 Released! Demo Updated to Latest Version!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

This version has a few bug fixes. I also updated the Demo, as it was based on a May 2021 release, and didn't contain the latest fixes etc.

Here's the full changelog for 2022-004:

FIX: Potentially fixed an issue with AI cars being very slow in Battle Arena's after some time.

Thanks for the support everyone!

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-018 Released! Fuel/Tyre Wear, 2 new tracks based on Real Locations!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This update has been a little while in the works, and in preparation for the Career mode that I'm working on for TRF, I've added Tyre Wear and Fuel to the game.

These are both somewhat experimental features, to use them you need to enable "Fuel/Tyre Wear" as a mutator for your event. It only works in the 'Race' game mode, and it only works on tracks which have at least 8 pit buildings placed in them.

If you are making tracks, make sure the pit stops are close to the track, and easily accessible, as the AI basically need to be near a pit and have a straight line to the pit in order to use them.

2 new tracks have also been added to the game, which have support for pit stops, they are based in Britain and Australia, specifically on Silverstone and Albert Park.

There is also a bunch of bug fixes which has fixed some new as well as longstanding issues, here's the full patch notes:

2021-018 (30-11-2021):

ADD: Added Real World Location Track: Australia
ADD: Added Real World Location Track: Britain
ADD: Added Fuel usage to cars. (Activated by a Mutator)
ADD: Added Tyre wear to cars. (Activated by a Mutator)
ADD: Pit stop buildings can now be used to refuel and replace tyres. 8 Pit stops must be on the track to work.
NOTE: Pit Stops must be placed on/near the track to work, as the AI need a clear path to drive to them from the racing line.

FIX: Fix an issue where terrain was incorrectly placed when loading up a track in the editor.
FIX: Finally fixed the pit-stop building collision issues.
FIX: Fixed no maps being available for Kill Trail mode.
FIX: Fixed some terrain detection issues where terrain was misplaced by 2000 pixels to the North West.
FIX: Fixed AI not being slowed down by being on a poor terrain type.
FIX: Terrain is now visible again on the main menu.
FIX: Gamepads will no longer vibrate for no reason when the car is stationary.
FIX: Fixed the wrong part of the track being visually "underwater" in both the game and track previews.
FIX: Fixed some terrain decals being incorrectly placed on water.

Thanks for your support!

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-017 Released, Fixes Time Trial Mode, Changed Terrain Editor
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This patch fixes a few issues with the game, mainly with the time trial mode, I noticed World Record ghosts were not being uploaded to the server, and also sometimes ghost files never got through either. This patch should fix most of the issues with this, alongside some other things.

Full Patch Notes:

2021-017 (28-11-2021):

CHANGE: Altered the way terrain editing works in the editor, you now select what terrain you want and click to make it that, rather than hold left click to gradually raise/lower land. Brush Strength values closer to 1 are higher terrain, 0.2 is deep water.
CHANGE: Optimized the AI to use less CPU resources.
CHANGE: Changed how AI sounds are processed, reduces their CPU usage by about 30%.
CHANGE: Internal game engine updated, for more stability.
CHANGE: Map sizes are now adjusted when entering a level to try and prevent the camera not being able to center each players car at the edge of tracks.

FIX: Fixed an issue in certain weather conditions where a rectangle would appear around Player 1.
FIX: Fixed an issue where Players 2-4 would not see rain on their screens in the "Rain" weather condition.
FIX: Prevented leaving a time trial when you have gotten the WR time but the ghost has not yet uploaded.
FIX: Fixed an issue where sometimes your time wouldn't be saved when finishing a time trial.
FIX: Fixed a potential crash when editing terrain outside the world map in the track editor.
FIX: Fixed an issue where your ghost data would not be uploaded to the server when getting World Record.

REMOVE: Removed some additional debug text shown during a Kill Trail game.

Thanks for your support!
- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-016 Released, TRF's 1st anniversary! New Game Mode, Dynamic Weather
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's now been 1 year since TRF launched on Steam, thank you all for your support!

To celebrate, a new update is being released, this update adds a new game mode that is playable by up to 4 players.

It is based on the TRON/Snake, where each car leaves a trail behind it, and has to try and make the other drivers hit their trail, whilst not slowing down themselves, or hitting another trail, including their own!

Alongside this, dynamic rain and dynamic snow are appearing as new weather types, when the weather is set to these, the intensity of rain/snow will vary throughout the race, causing changing driving conditions and visibility.

I hope you all enjoy this update, here's the full changelog:

2021-016 (27-10-2021):

ADD: Added a new game mode: Kill Trail, for up to 4 players.
ADD: New Weather Type: Dynamic Rain
ADD: New Weather Type: Dynamic Snow
ADD: Added some new AI names for the AI drivers to choose from.

CHANGE: Updated to a newer engine version, improving stability.
CHANGE: Re-balanced some weapon presets.
CHANGE: Adjusted and optimized the particles system.
CHANGE: Optimized the culling system for objects out of view, should have increased performance on large, busy tracks.
CHANGE: Some default settings changed, zoom level changed from 1.25 to 1.5, and the track map is now on by default.

FIX: Fixed the collision box for Pit buildings.
FIX: Fixed multiple errors related to event results and tournament standings when there are less than 8 cars in an event.
FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur when there were less than 8 cars in an event.
FIX: Fixed an issue where the rev counter wasn't visible even when on manual transmission.
FIX: The Championship name no longer overlaps other text in the championship map screen.
FIX: Basic terrain is now drawn in the championship map screen.
FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur when getting World Record while offline, and then getting a slower World Record online.
FIX: Fixed an issue where Cops & Racers events wouldn't end after all racers have been eliminated when there's less than 8 cars.
FIX: Fixed an issue where your time wouldn't be uploaded to the Steam leaderboards if the first attempt to upload the time failed.
FIX: Fixed an issue where drivers would not be properly introduced to the game if you lowered the car limit below 4 and changed game modes.
FIX: Fixed an issue where the "joined players" panels at the bottom would incorrectly light up if there was less than 4 cars in an event.
FIX: Fixed an issue where sometimes log fences would not be destroyed correctly.

notes.title: Version 2021-013 Released! Cops & Racers game mode, new tracks, new features!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I've been working really hard over April and into May to bring you this latest update to TRF, with the longest changelog yet!

The major changes are:

Cops & Racers game mode added.
5 New Tracks added.
Extra objects to place in the editor.
Gamepad support in the Track Editor
32-bit Support Removed, the game now requires a 64-bit OS.
Online play has been removed.
A ton of bug fixes.

The removal of online play was a sad moment for me, but the content I was able to add because of its removal was worth it in my opinion, and I think the majority of the players will benefit from it.

Here are the full patch notes for this release:

2021-013 (11-05-2021):

From this point onwards TRF requires a 64-bit OS. 32-bit may be able to continue to be unofficially supported on another branch, but you should not purchase the game unless you use a 64-bit OS.

ADD: Added a new Game Mode: Cops & Racers
ADD: Added a new Race Track: Grass Raceway 4
ADD: Added a new Race Track: Mt. Raceway 2
ADD: Added a new Race Track: Desert Oasis
ADD: Added a new Race Track: Ocean Raceway 3
ADD: Added a new Race Track: Calden Park
ADD: Added a new placeable object: Small Boost Pad.
ADD: Added 2 new tree variants: Palm Trees.
ADD: Added a new track piece: Half-length Straight.
ADD: Added the ability to choose weapon pre-sets for events: Normal, Bolts & Shields, Nitro Only, No Weapons.
ADD: Gamepad support added for the track editor.
ADD: You can now use LB/RB on an Xbox controller to navigate the level select pages.
ADD: Experimental support for spawning cars near where the previous round ended on Advanced tracks in Elimination mode. Previously you always started from the start/finish line in Elimination mode on Advanced tracks.

CHANGE: The base game engine has been updated.
CHANGE: Executable is now a 64-bit exe, not 32-bit, this brings a big improvement to performance.
CHANGE: When using Up/Down or LB/RB to change selected object in the track editor, the page will keep up with the selected objects page.
CHANGE: Boost/Slow Pads now light-up so they are more visible at night.
CHANGE: Off-road detection on 90 degree corners is slightly less forgiving again.
CHANGE: Off-road detection on 45 & 180 degree corners should be more accurate.
CHANGE: Weapon Balancing largely changed. Last is more likely to get nitros and strikes, first is more likely to get shields.
CHANGE: Improved the way that log fences detect collisions.
CHANGE: Changed how vehicles get eliminated in Elimination mode.
CHANGE: Made the camera focus on the cars quicker at the start of each round in Elimination.
CHANGE: Changed possible spawn locations for restarting an Elimination round, should produce better results.
CHANGE: Temporarily removed Team Standings table at the end of a Team event.
CHANGE: The lobby should handle correcting the number of laps better, and stop defaulting to "3" at the end of each event.
CHANGE: You can no longer use the "Sim Racing" mutator in Zen mode.
CHANGE: Improved the quality of the explosion created by meteors.
CHANGE: Improved the quality of the explosion made by vehicles exploding in Pass The Bomb.
CHANGE: AI will now attempt to reverse if they're stuck driving into a wall in Battle Arena's.
CHANGE: AI will now take slight avoiding action to avoid crashing into other cars in races.

FIX: You can now select all objects/track pieces in the track editor using Up/Down again.
FIX: Selecting car horns in car select should now work again.
FIX: Fixed a crash when saving a Neon track in the new editor.
FIX: Fixed a long-standing issue that prevented cars from finishing in sprint races at times.
FIX: You can no longer start a team-based event when all players are set to the same team.
FIX: The "Scale" options in the track editor should now be visible/invisible at the correct times.
FIX: Fixed an issue where edited terrain wouldn't be loaded for WIP maps.
FIX: Fixed an issue where terrain would be made "deeper" each time you saved and loaded a track.
FIX: Fixed an issue with Elimination mode where racers would be incorrectly eliminated.
FIX: Fixed an issue with Elimination mode which means the camera should correctly focus on the lead car more often.
FIX: Fixed an issue with Elimination mode where the AI couldn't earn points properly.
FIX: Fixed an issue where terrain would not correctly display in the lobby.
FIX: Fixed an issue where AI head/brakelights would be visible in Drift and Zen modes.
FIX: Fixed an issue where particles sometimes wouldn't appear when vehicles were eliminated in Pass The Bomb.
FIX: Fixed an issue where Boats could not move properly on Basic Tracks made in the Water environment.
FIX: Fixed an issue where vehicles would not correctly detect they were in water.
FIX: Fixed a crash when exiting a track that had a spinning hammer/bar in it.
FIX: Spinning bars/hammers will now reset to their original rotation after ending a test in the track editor.
FIX: Fixed an anti-cheat issue with one of the tracks.
FIX: Tyre screeching sounds, as well as gravel sounds, will now correctly play on Advanced Tracks.

REMOVE: Network mode has been removed.

As always, please report any bugs you find and any suggestions you have either in the forums here on Steam, or over on the TRF Discord server at: https://bit.ly/2OIgGPq

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-009 Released
notes.notes:
This patch adds 1 new song that can play during events, as well as adding a dead tree perhaps better suited to Winter themed tracks. Some (hopefully) subtle turbo noises have been added to certain car classes.

There was also a complete change in how the game handles scaling, let me know if this causes issues, but it should result in better image quality, especially in resolutions such as 1440p and 4k.

Elimination mode has temporarily been disabled for online play, as there are issues with it that make it pretty much unplayable right now, as such you won't be able to select it as a mode in the online lobby.

Here are the full patch notes:

2021-009 (27/02/2021):

ADD: Added 1 new song to the playlist in events.
ADD: Added an extra tree variant: Dead tree.
ADD: Turbo noises have been added for player cars.

CHANGE: The pitch of the Formula engine has been adjusted.
CHANGE: Changed the way track pieces are sometimes handled, so snowy track pieces shouldn't get changed to non-snowy ones if you select snowy weather.
CHANGE: When waiting at race results as client, it now says you are waiting for the host to continue.
CHANGE: Changed the way resolution scaling is handled, should result in a better quality image in resolutions above 720p.
CHANGE: Elimination mode has been temporarily disabled for online play. This is due to bugs making it unplayable over a network.
CHANGE: Changed how the HUD is drawn again, meaning less calculations need to be done per frame.

FIX: Fixed a weird graphic artefact on tree variant #2.
FIX: Vehicles in Zen mode now have their correct engine sounds.

REMOVE: The AA graphics option has been removed, it didn't really improve graphics and caused extreme performance hits on high resolutions.

I hope you're all enjoying TRF, thanks for your support.

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-005 Released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A new patch, 2021-005 is released today.

This patch adds the ability to rebind controls. Controls for P1 on keyboard are now defaulted to WASD. Please check the controls menu in options to set your controls how you like them. And let me know if there are issues with the rebinding.

There is a new option to allow 2 players to play on 1 keyboard also. Keyboard Controls are for the first keyboard player, and Keyboard 2 Controls are for the 2nd keyboard player. Tick the "2 Player Keyboard" checkbox in the controls menu to allow 2 players to use keyboard.

This patch also fixes several issues with multi-event tournaments.

Here are the full patch notes:

2021-005 (19/02/2021):

ADD: Added the option to rebind keyboard and gamepad controls.
ADD: Added the option to change the vehicle class for the event mid-tournament.
ADD: Added a toggle in the options menu under 'controls' to allow 2 players to play with keyboard controls.
ADD: P1-4 can now have separately configured Deadzones and Vibration feedback settings for their gamepads.
ADD: Added Twitter and Discord buttons to the main menu.

CHANGE: Resetting in Time Trial mode is now binded to your car reset key. Instead of always to "R".

FIX: You can no longer play user-made tracks in time trial mode, this wasn't intended and results in a crash.
FIX: You can no longer drive a land vehicle on a water track when switching between the two mid-tournament.
FIX: When changing between race modes and battle modes mid-tournament, the correct maps will now be available in the map select.
FIX: You can no longer start a mid-tournament event with incorrect settings.
FIX: Fixed additional HUD misalignment issues.
FIX: Fixed misaligned text on the player drop-in/out system if P3 or P4 was using a keyboard.
FIX: Fixed an issue where the camera wouldn't focus on the car correctly on battle arena's during a tournament.
FIX: Fixed a crash when switching between a race game mode and battle game mode during a tournament.

REMOVE: The "P" button no longer pauses the game, please use ESC instead.
REMOVE: Removed some debug keys that were accidentally left in to observe AI cars.

I hope you're all enjoying TRF, thank you for your support so far!

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-004 Released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A new patch, 2021-004 is released today.

This patch adds a new options menu, as well as some additional options to choose from. It also fixes some further HUD issues.

Please note that only one set of controls now works in the game. As such WASD no longer controls the car, you must use the arrow keys for now. This is because the input system is in the middle of a rewrite, a later patch in February will allow you to rebind your keys.

Here are the full patch notes:

2021-004 (18/02/2021):

ADD: Added a button that takes you to the games forums on the main menu.
ADD: Added some "did you know" text to the main menu.
ADD: Added the option to enable/disable V-Sync in the options menu. Has been disabled until now.
ADD: Added the option to control level of Anti-Aliasing in the options menu. Has been set to 0x until now.
ADD: A new set of logos is available to put on cars.

CHANGE: Options menu has been revamped into tabs. To allow more options to be available.
CHANGE: Secondary controls are no longer in the game, please us the arrow keys for driving right now, not WASD.
This will change in a patch later in February.

FIX: Gamepad players can now use their horn using the Horn button.
FIX: The rev counter is now visible again when using manual transmission.
FIX: The boost bar is now visible again when using the Boost Bar mutator.
FIX: Fixed P1's weapon HUD being offset slightly.
FIX: Fixed a crash when a player's gamepad became disconnected in the menus.
FIX: Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't properly change to fullscreen when clicking the "apply" button in options.
FIX: The "back" button should no longer move around the screen when changing resolutions in the options menu.
FIX: Buttons missing in the track editor in fullscreen are now back again.
FIX: Fixed the DNF timer being mis-aligned.
FIX: Fixed the race results/tournament standings being drawn in the wrong place.

There will be a further update in February that will add additional options to the options menu, as well as some more content.

I hope you're all enjoying TRF, thank you for your support so far!

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2021-003 Released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A new patch, 2021-003 is released today.

This patch mainly focuses on fixing errors with the resolution changing and fullscreen/windowed transition. A lot of times, the UI was incorrectly displayed in various resolutions and whether you were in fullscreen or not.

Also 2 new track pieces were added, 45 and 180 degree corners, for shallow and tighter turns respectively.

Here are the full patch notes:

2021-003 (11/02/2021):

NOTE: Available resolutions have changed, please check your resolution options when next playing.

ADD: 21:9 resolutions have been added to the resolution select.
ADD: A new track piece has been added, 45 degree corner.
ADD: A new track piece has been added, 180 degree corner.
ADD: Added text pop-up when rotating object in the track editor, to let you know how much rotation you have.

CHANGE: Optimized the way HUD is drawn, should give slight performance gains, especially in split-screen.
CHANGE: Reduced amount of HUD drawn in Zen mode, so less of the screen is used by HUD elements.
CHANGE: The track map will now only draw in single-player & network events. No longer in split-screen.
CHANGE: Black background added when the "confirm resolution change" text appears after changing resolution, makes the text easier to read.
CHANGE: The track map will now only draw the track on race tracks, it will not draw the "track" when in Battle Arena's.
CHANGE: The dirt decal for S-Curve track pieces no longer uses the standard corner dirt decal, fitting the track better.
CHANGE: There is now text to warn you if you have achieved a World Record on a track, but your ghost has not yet been uploaded. Please wait on the finish screen until the ghost has been uploaded.

FIX: Fixed a bug where sprint tracks wouldn't be limited to 1 lap.
FIX: You can now properly select car colour when in fullscreen and in non-16:9 resolutions.
FIX: Menu buttons should now be clickable regardless of resolution or window/fullscreen mode.
FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur when entering the lobby in a non-16:9 resolution.
FIX: Some HUD was displayed incorrectly in 3 or 4 player split-screen races.
FIX: In-Race HUD's for all game modes should now fit properly regardless of resolution.
FIX: The transition fade now covers the entire game when in a non-16:9 resolution.
FIX: Fixed a bug that could result in a game-mode and track type mismatch, mainly in network games.
FIX: The in-game pause menu is now properly aligned with the screen regardless of resolution or window/fullscreen mode.
FIX: Players can now respray their cars simultaneously in split-screen multiplayer. Each car has their own colour chart again.
FIX: Player/Car 4 can now adjust their car cosmetics and settings again.
FIX: Steam Workshop image previews of tracks/arenas should now be taken correctly regardless of resolution or fullscreen/windowed.
FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur when returning to main menu in a non-16:9 resolution.
FIX: Map preview is no longer visible behind the event settings window.
FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur when returning to the Time Trial track select in a non-16:9 resolution.

There will be a further update in February that will be more "content" related, rather than fixes. This just had the priority for what I wanted done soon.

I hope you're all enjoying TRF, thank you for your support so far!

notes.title: Version 2020-038 Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's time for another update!

This one is primarily a bug fix, it disables a feature of the game engine which could cause crashes, which was unknown to me, but I was recently made aware that the game engine had a flaw in it that is being worked on by the developers of the engine.

There were also other bug fixes, mostly relating to the new Bus vehicle class, and also some changes to how things are handled. I also found better ways of achieving the same result in a few cases, which has made the game use less resources.

Here's the full patch notes for this version:

2020-038 (11/12/2020):

CHANGE: Optimized the frameskipping method, so the CPU overhead is reduced when 30FPS mode is enabled.
CHANGE: Optimized the way the position list is drawn, should now use less GPU resources.
CHANGE: Changed the background of the map preview to reflect newer graphics.
CHANGE: Players can now be any team they wish in Return the Flag mode.
CHANGE: AI will no longer fire indiscriminately at cars on the same team.

FIX: Bus icon is now scaled correctly in the HUD.
FIX: Disabled the game engines built-in garbage collector, which was causing game crashes.
FIX: The flag is now visible in Return the Flag mode before being picked up.

I hope you're all enjoying the game, thanks for the support so far!

- Oliver

notes.title: Version 2020-037 Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's time for another update!

This one adds a new vehicle class, Busses!

These are big, heavy vehicles. Slow turning, slow moving... just slow at everything really! They're pretty long too, similar to trucks, but not articulated, so they're tougher to manoeuvre around tracks.

A pretty big memory issue was also fixed, meaning the amount of RAM used during a race is much reduced.

Here's the full patch notes for the past 2 versions, as they released close together:

2020-037 (04/12/2020):

CHANGE: Changed location of the wheels on Busses.
CHANGE: Changed the particle effects for Busses.
CHANGE: Made collision box a bit smaller for Busses.

2020-036 (03/12/2020):

ADD: Added a new vehicle class:  Busses

CHANGE: Done a large optimization on how the terrain is placed, drastically reducing RAM usage.

FIX: Fixed a potential memory leak linked to the shop.

I hope you're all enjoying the game, thanks for the support so far!

- Oliver

notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's time for another update!

This one adds a new mutator which adds a "boost bar" to the game, holding Z or E will activate your boost. It recharges over-time, and using a Nitro power-up will give you a full bar of boost instead of boosting your car if the mutator is turned on.

The S-Curve track piece added previously has had a complementary track piece added with it, so it can now be rotated and placed in all directions.

There was also some optimizations and bug fixes in this patch.

Here's the full patch notes for this version:

2020-035 (18/11/2020):

ADD: Added a second Chicane/S-Curve track piece to allow them to be placed in all positions.
ADD: Added an event mutator to have a Boost Bar that gradually fills instead of Nitro power-ups.

CHANGE: Optimized the "speed-trail" particle effect.
CHANGE: When using Nitro power-up with the Boost Bar mutator enabled, the Nitro will instead fill your boost.
CHANGE: AI are now smarter in their Nitro use and can use Nitro on tracks without track pieces.
CHANGE: Updated in-game manual with new controls.
CHANGE: Greatly optimized how wall shadows are handled.
CHANGE: Wall shadows are now displayed for Players 2, 3 & 4 in split-screen due to optimizations.

FIX: Prevented changing of rotation during testing in the editor.
FIX: Fixed a bug where a default track wouldn't be loaded upon entering Time Attack mode.
FIX: Rev counters are now visible in split-screen when P2/P3/P4 have manual gears enabled.
FIX: Rev counter is now accurate to your car when in network games.
FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur when finishing with manual gears.
FIX: Changing gears with gamepad no longer changes gears more than once.
FIX: Event settings tooltips now show accurately when controlling menus with a gamepad.

I hope you're all enjoying the game, thanks for the support so far!

- Oliver

notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This one adds an extra menu option to "download tracks", this will allow you to view and subscribe (or unsubscribe) to items in the Steam Workshop from within the game itself. Meaning you can go into there, download a user-made track, and then go straight to a Custom Event and play on that track/arena.

It also adds a new "S-Curve" track piece to the track editor, for more varied tracks. And you can now hold the CTRL key down when in the track editor, which allows you to change the 32x32 placement grid, to a 2x2 placement grid while it's held, allowing for more finer placement of track pieces and objects, and rotating whilst holding CTRL, also allows you to do more finer rotation of objects.

Here's the full patch notes for this version:

2020-034 (02/11/2020):

ADD: Added new Chicane/S-Curve track piece.
ADD: You can now hold CTRL to finely place track/objects in the editor and adjust their rotation.
ADD: Added a toggle option in Options to enable/disable gamepad vibration.
ADD: You can now download user-made tracks & arenas from within the game.

CHANGE: Updated the game engine, for better performance and stability.
CHANGE: Edited the colouring of the Armco Straight and Armco Corner objects.
CHANGE: Change file structure to allow for greater compatibility with Linux.

FIX: Fixed a crash that could occur in time trial mode when finishing a lap.

I hope you're all enjoying the game, thanks for the support so far!

- Oliver

notes.title: Game Features planned for June Release
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Today's post is just a summary of all that the game is planned to have for its launch in June.

Here's what the game is planned to have:

Gamemodes: 

At least 8, currently we have 7:

Race: Simple racing gamemode, finish the set number of laps, features weapons which can be turned on and off. 1-4 Players, played on race tracks.

Elimination: Shared-screen eliminator mode, think Micro-Machines, falling off the screen is death. Last car standing wins a point, first to set number of points wins. 1-8 Players, played on race tracks.

Drift: A target score is generated for the track, drift around corners and keep your combos on the straights to earn big points, car collisions are disabled. 1-4 Players, played on race tracks.

Zen: A target score is generated for the track, your cars power is constantly increasing, your car is always accelerating and there are no brakes, you earn points when driving around the track, but if you fall off the track, your points stop increasing. The driver who stays on the track the most when time runs out is the winner here! 1-4 Players, played on race tracks.

Infection: 1 Player starts as infected, their aim is to infect all the other cars by touching them. If a player becomes infected, they then have to infect other cars to earn points. Try to stay alive until the timer runs out to win in this game mode! 1-8 Players, played on battle arenas.

Pass The Bomb: A bomb is randomly placed on a car, they have to touch someone to pass it to them, if you have the bomb when the fuse runs out, BOOM, you're out of the event. Surviving as long as possible is how you earn points here. 1-8 Players, played on battle arenas.

Hold The Gold: A gold bar is placed somewhere on the map, race to pick it up, and then hold onto it for as long as you can! Being hit by another car will transfer the gold to them, whoever holds the gold earns points. Holding the gold for the most amount of time when the timer runs out will win you the event! 1-8 Players, played on battle arenas.

Track Editor:

There will be a fully-functioning track editor in the final game. It's what I've used to make all the tracks currently in the game. It's capable of making both Race Tracks and Battle Arenas. It contains a racing-line editor so you can tune the AI to your standards, as well as determining what classes as "cheating" on your race tracks, stopping people from cutting corners.

4 Car Classes, each with 8 cars to drive:

There are 4 car classes in the game, Street, Sports, Super & Hyper.

Car performance in each class is identical, however there are 8 styles of car in each class you can choose from. Sports is the default class, and is recommended for most drivers to start with, Hyper is for more advanced drivers who want a challenge.

Controller Support:

The following controllers have been tested and work with TRF: Xbox 360 Controller, Xbox One Controller, Dualshock 4. Mouse & Keyboard also work.

Local Multiplayer Support:

All game modes support at least 4 players, and some game modes support up to 8 players. Every game mode also has support for AI Drivers that will fill up the grid. When playing 1-4 player, the screen will be split. 5-8 player games, the screen will be zoomed out so everyone can fit on the screen.

Weather & Time of Day:

The game has various weather conditions for you to choose from:

Clear, Rain, Stormy, Snow, Blizzard, Meteor.

Adverse weather conditions will affect car performance, so don't expect to stay on the road in a blizzard! And Meteor showers can really switch up a race.

There are also time of day settings to choose from, Dawn, Day, Dusk & Night.

Mutators:

Along with the standard event settings, such as amount of laps, weather and time of day, there are also extra "Mutators" you can set for an event.

These range from adding the Zen mode "Always Accelerating" feature to any game mode. Or making the road permanently icy, as though you were in a blizzard. You could even turn off the "drafting" feature, if it's annoying you that people keep catching you up in Infection!

This covers most of what the game has.

Have a good day everyone!
